cues.en: In this video I'm going to show you how to compute powers, that is exponents, using Python.
cues.zh: 這段影片示範如何用 Python 計算冪，也就是次方。

cues.en: I'll also introduce you to the law of exponents in case you're not familiar with the law of exponents.
cues.zh: 如果不熟悉指數律，我也會介紹。

cues.en: If you are familiar with the law of exponents, then this will be a useful reminder.
cues.zh: 如果已經熟悉，就當作實用的複習。

cues.en: And you're also going to learn a little bit more about printing out really nice looking mathematical expressions in python using LaTeX.
cues.zh: 你也會多學一點，在 Python 裡透過 LaTeX 印出漂亮數學式的方法。

cues.en: So raising one number to a power of another number in this case three to the power of two, which is also called three squared, simply means multiplying the base number by itself
cues.zh: 把一個數字取另一個數字的次方，例如 3 的 2 次方，也稱為 3 的平方，就是把底數和自己相乘，

cues.en: this number of times. So three squared equals three times three and therefore three to the Power of Four means three times three times three times three.
cues.zh: 指定的次數。所以 3 的平方等於 3 乘以 3；3 的 4 次方，就是 3 乘以 3 乘以 3 乘以 3。

cues.en: So we have four threes that all get multiplied here.
cues.zh: 這裡有四個 3，全都乘在一起。

cues.en: Then we get to something called the law of exponents which sounds really fancy and formal but it basically just means that if you have the same base then you can add the exponents.
cues.zh: 接著是指數律，聽起來很正式、很厲害，但基本上只是：底數相同時，可以把指數相加。

cues.en: So in this case we have three to the power of two times three to the power of four.
cues.zh: 例如，3 的 2 次方乘以 3 的 4 次方，

cues.en: And this is equivalent to -- this is the same thing as -- we can rewrite this expression as three to the power of two plus four.
cues.zh: 等同於，也就是可以改寫為，3 的 2 加 4 次方。

cues.en: And you have to be mindful that the plus four is also in the exponent here.
cues.zh: 要注意，加上 4 也在指數裡。

cues.en: So this is not three squared plus four this is three to the power of two plus four which is three to the power of six.
cues.zh: 所以不是 3 平方再加 4，而是 3 的括號 2 加 4 次方，也就是 3 的 6 次方。

cues.en: And basically that means multiplying three out six times.
cues.zh: 基本上就是六個 3 相乘。

cues.en: Now the law of exponents also states that this is only possible when the base is the same.
cues.zh: 指數律也說明，只有底數相同時才能這樣做。

cues.en: So in this case we have three to the power of two times four to the power of three.
cues.zh: 例如這裡是 3 的 2 次方，乘以 4 的 3 次方。

cues.en: And you can't really simplify this much further, so you can write out three times three which is this
cues.zh: 就無法再這樣簡化。可以把 3 乘以 3 寫出來，這是這，

cues.en: term times four times four times four which is this term and then you can multiply them altogether.
cues.zh: 一項，再乘以 4 乘以 4 乘以 4，也就是這一項，最後全部相乘。

cues.en: But it's not possible to simplify the exponents because the base term is different.
cues.zh: 但底數不同，所以不能把指數簡化。

cues.en: OK.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: So now let's switch to Python and see how to compute powers in python
cues.zh: 切換到 Python，看看如何計算次方。

cues.zh: Python 裡取次方，其實也是用星號，但要用兩個。

cues.en: And that means to raise three to the second power.
cues.zh: 這代表 3 的 2 次方。

cues.en: So there the answer is going to be nine of course because three times three is nine. One easy to make mistake is say three caret.
cues.zh: 答案當然是 9，因為 3 乘以 3 是 9。很容易犯的錯，是寫 3 接尖角符號，

cues.en: -- This is called the caret symbol -- two.

cues.en: So sometimes people would write an expression like this and they mean three squared.

cues.en: So three caret two is not the same thing as three squared.

cues.en: So you just have to be a bit mindful of that.
cues.zh: 這點要留意。
